acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: proteins were reduced in 10 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma-Aldrich) for 30 min at 37°C and alkylated in 55 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich) for 20 min at RT protected from light.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: proteins were reduced in 10 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma-Aldrich) for 30 min at 37°C and alkylated in 55 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich) for 20 min at RT protected from light.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested with trypsin, as described in Shevchenko et al.

collision_energy.evidence: MS2 was performed in the Ion trap at rapid scan mode with ion target of 2.0e4 and higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) fragmentation with normalized collision energy of 27.

The isolation window in the quadrupole was set at 1.4 Thomson. Only ions with charge between 2 and 7 were selected for MS2. For Q Exactive, MS1 spectra were recorded at 70,000 resolution and the top 10 most abundant peaks with charge ≥ 2 and isolation window of 2.0 Thomson were selected and also fragmented by HCD fragmentation of 27.
